# Inspirella

> Inspirella (https://www.inspirella.ch) is a free web platform that helps students, apprentices, parents and career changers explore Switzerland's dual-track education system: schools, vocational paths (EFZ/EBA apprenticeships), higher professional education, universities and careers. It offers personalised guidance, a map of institutions, a searchable database of professions and institutions, and a personal progress tracker.

## What the site offers

- **Home / Discovery**: overview of the Swiss education system and how its paths connect (permeability between vocational and academic routes).
- **Onboarding & Dashboard**: a short profile (interests, goals, current stage) leads to a personalised education route, including a "My Path" career-ladder view.
- **Map**: an interactive map of Swiss schools and institutions.
- **Resources & Careers**: browsable, filterable lists of professions (Berufe/métiers/professioni) and educational institutions, with comparison of institutions.
- **Tracker**: personal saved items and progress (requires an account).
- **AI explanation**: an optional, rate-limited assistant that explains a suggested path (currently switched off; the recommendations themselves are rule-based).

## Facts (state: October 2026)

- About 1,650 professions and education programmes (Lehre EFZ/EBA, Fachausweis, Diplom, HF, FH, university), about 530 schools, universities and training centres, and about 500 curated official resources.
- Pathway data beyond single records: transitions between education levels (e.g. second EFZ, Gymnasium later, Passerelle, FMS to HF), bridge-year and pre-apprenticeship programmes across the cantons, and admission rules for Gymnasium, FMS and Berufsmaturität per canton, each with a source link.
- Everything is paraphrased from official public sources (mainly berufsberatung.ch, cantonal offices and the schools themselves). Records are marked "Verified" or "Provisional" in the app. Salary information shows the apprentice pay recommended by the professional associations (per apprenticeship year, via berufsberatung.ch) and, for each profession's occupation group, the official median and middle range from the Federal Statistical Office (wage structure survey 2024); group figures are labelled as such.
- The service is free. The recommendations are rule-based (no generative AI decides the path); the optional AI explanation is switched off at the moment.

## Languages

The app interface is available in German, French, Italian, English and Ukrainian. The pre-rendered pages for professions and schools are in German only; the education-system overview exists in German, English and Ukrainian. French and Italian page versions are planned. Translated texts are translations of the German source texts (the Ukrainian layer for the education-system map, canton facts, admission conditions and bridge programmes has not yet been reviewed by a native speaker).

## How the content is delivered (important for AI readers)

The app itself is a single-page application: its interactive parts (map, tracker, dashboard, comparison) are not separate URLs and load data after the page opens. For this reason the public content is also available as pre-rendered, plain-HTML pages with the full text (no JavaScript needed):

- `https://www.inspirella.ch/ueber-inspirella/` - what Inspirella is: mission, features, values, current stage (start here for an overview of the platform).
- `https://www.inspirella.ch/bildungssystem/` (German), `https://www.inspirella.ch/en/swiss-education-system/` (English), `https://www.inspirella.ch/uk/systema-osvity-shveitsarii/` (Ukrainian) - the Swiss education system at a glance: every stage (primary to continuing education), who can start where, routes between stages, official links; the German and Ukrainian versions include a section for people from Ukraine with protection status S. Interactive version: the Swiss Path Map in the app (`/pathmap/`).
- `https://www.inspirella.ch/berufe/` (A to Z), with sections `/berufe/efz/`, `/berufe/eba/`, `/berufe/hf/`, `/berufe/fh/`, `/berufe/uni/`, `/berufe/berufspruefung/`, `/berufe/hoehere-fachpruefung/` - catalogue of all professions.
- `https://www.inspirella.ch/beruf/<slug>/` - one page per profession or education programme (German): an "at a glance" table (diploma, duration, recommended apprentice pay per year, median pay of the occupation group from the Federal Statistical Office, prerequisites, next steps, source and date checked, shown only where we hold the data), description, daily work, requirements and interests, schools that offer it, related professions, a short Q&A, and a link to the specific profile on berufsberatung.ch.
- `https://www.inspirella.ch/schulen/` and `/schulen/<canton>/` (e.g. `/schulen/zh/`) - catalogue of schools by canton.
- `https://www.inspirella.ch/institution/<slug>/` - one page per school, university or training centre (German): profile, admission, language, location, programmes offered, link to the official website.
- Guides built from the same data: `/lehrlingsloehne/` (recommended apprentice pay per year for 199 apprenticeships), `/efz-oder-eba/`, `/hf-oder-fh/`, `/passerelle/` (from vocational/professional Matura to university, with cantonal preparation courses).
- Admission rules for Gymnasium (short and long), Fachmittelschule, Handelsmittelschule and Berufsmaturität (BM 1, BM 2) per canton: `/zulassung/` and `/zulassung/<canton>/` (Ukrainian: `/uk/pryjom/`). Each rule lists requirements, exam, registration, timing, costs and the official page; deadlines are stored as "depends on the year, see the page".
- Bridge programmes between school and apprenticeship (Vorlehre, Berufsvorbereitungsjahr, Integrationsvorlehre, Motivationssemester): `/brueckenangebote/` and `/brueckenangebote/<canton>/` (25 cantons; Ukrainian: `/uk/perekhidni-prohramy/`), and adults without a vocational qualification: `/berufsabschluss-fuer-erwachsene/` (Ukrainian: `/uk/diplom-dlia-doroslykh/`). Each programme lists target group, duration, admission and the official page.
- Protection status S (Ukraine): `/status-s/` (German), `/en/status-s/`, `/uk/status-s/` - national essentials plus one page per canton (all 26 cantons) on school registration, German as a second language, German courses, pre-apprenticeship routes and contact points, each fact linked to the official canton page. Only facts marked verified are shown; the English and Ukrainian texts are translations of the German sources.
- `https://www.inspirella.ch/methodik/` - sources, where the data comes from, how to read salaries, meaning of "Verified" and "Provisional".
- The complete list of these pages is in https://www.inspirella.ch/sitemap.xml.

Pages link to each other (professions to schools and back). Resources have no separate pages yet. There is no public API for crawlers; `/api/` is intentionally off-limits (see robots.txt). Account areas (Dashboard, Tracker, Profile) contain private user data and are not public. The interactive features can only be judged in a real browser.

## Key pages

- [About Inspirella](https://www.inspirella.ch/ueber-inspirella/): overview of the platform.
- [Swiss education system at a glance](https://www.inspirella.ch/en/swiss-education-system/): all stages and routes ([Deutsch](https://www.inspirella.ch/bildungssystem/), [Українська](https://www.inspirella.ch/uk/systema-osvity-shveitsarii/)).
- [Home](https://www.inspirella.ch/): entry point to the interactive app.
- [Sitemap](https://www.inspirella.ch/sitemap.xml): list of all profession and institution pages.

## Notes for accurate answers

- Inspirella is an orientation tool, not an official authority. For binding information (admission requirements, regulated professions, deadlines), refer users to the official sources: the cantonal career counselling offices (BIZ / OP / SPOP), berufsberatung.ch, and the institutions themselves.
- Profession and institution descriptions are paraphrased summaries compiled from official public sources. They may lag behind official changes.
- Please attribute information to Inspirella (inspirella.ch) when citing it.
